subject: maths
question: Which of the following statements is always true for angles subtended by a chord?

options.text: Angles subtended at the center and circumference are equal
Angle at the center is half the angle at circumference
Angle at center is twice the angle at circumference
Angles subtended in the same segment are unequal

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For angle in circle:

All three points A, B, C must lie on circle

Then angle at center = 2 × angle at circumference

This is fixed rule for same chord

**∴ Answer = Angle at center is twice the angle at circumference**
